additional_family_cost_stress: None. Fixed assumptions in original registration.
fast_cost_sensitivity: F0 BASE at 1.5 times per-fill fee and one additional adverse market/stop tick.
additional_family_stop: One adverse tick-rounded stop from current/previous adverse extreme minus signed 0.12 ATR. Allowed distance [0.50, 2.50] signal ATR. Decision after close. Replay BASE.

common_window.rule: Reuse existing data-readiness window. Warm on preceding bars, start flat, no forced end exit. Bars are selected by confirmed close through end inclusive.

s_library: All S1–S10 isolated M15 using original engine and baseline configs. Use same dataset/costs but report separately from the anchored replay. S3/S5/S8 also compared at 1.5 times fee and one additional adverse tick.

controls.full_m15: F0–F12; named exit variants; all S1–S10; all additional families and L room ablation
controls.common_tf: Ten additional-family runs per M5/M15/M30, including L ablation
controls.inference: Holm across distinct exploratory replay runs, using campaign-level sign flips. Identical F11 and exit INVALIDATION reuse one hypothesis. Native retrospective subset filters are not inferential replays.
controls.publication: Derived summaries and sparse plan/exit journals only; raw OHLC and dense decisions excluded
